quirks: inputSchema was null — the tweet ID MUST be supplied as a ?id=<tweetId> query string param on the URL (numeric snowflake ID, passed as a string e.g. id=20). There is no request body and no path param.
Endpoint name is /tweets/by/id (singular 'id'); do not confuse with a bulk/by-ids route.
Useful result is nested under body.data (not at the top level). The author profile is embedded at body.data.author.
Payment confirmed:false / txHash:null in qa-pay but status was 200 and real data returned — settlement is async via x402 facilitator; the response itself is the proof of success.
usage.guide: Call GET https://x402.twit.sh/tweets/by/id with the tweet's numeric ID as a query param: ?id=<tweetId> (e.g. ?id=20). It is an x402 paid endpoint (~$0.0025 USDC on Base, eip155:8453); send no request body. On success you get HTTP 200 with JSON; read the tweet from body.data.text, engagement from body.data.public_metrics, and the author profile from body.data.author. If you get a 4xx, verify the id is a valid numeric tweet snowflake ID passed as the ?id query param.
